main_text.p: & eo sane nomine fidei obedientia celebratur Rom.1.& alibi.

Quid vocat Paulus τὰ μὴ βλεπόμενα[?]: Naturam Dei, & angelicam, Christi Iesu historiam, electorum Ecclesiam, &c. Fides enim nos convincit, unam esse essentiam divinam, & tamen tres in ea distinctas personas: Mundum à Deo conditum esse: Deum in carne patefactum esse, &c.

Libet autem hoc loco addere Glossema in Proœmium Decretalium Gregorij, ut videant pij & studiosi iuuenes, quàm parum honorificè Paulinam fidei descriptionem, ductam ab effectis & materia circa quam, Canonistæ quidam tractaue[?] rint. Vt maximè enim aliquis det, non totam fidei naturam integra definitione, sed partem solùm, instituto de patientia & spe accommodatam, à Paulo expositā esse: tamen honorificentius Dei oraculū explicandū esse, nemo sanus inficias ibit. Verba Glossatoris hæc sunt:
Fides vero sic describitur ab Apostolo Hebr.11.[?] Fides est substantia rerum sperandarum, argumentū non apparentiū.
Et dicitur substantia sperandarum rerum, quia sperare debemus, quod dictum est

page.notes: Greek phrase after "Paulus" is printed in Greek letters; the accents and last word are uncertain. "Hebr.11." reference is doubtful. "tractaue rint" line break is unclear. Bottom right catchword "est" is partly under the last line and is read as the catchword. Section numbers and abbreviations kept as printed.
